about: Round 9, slice B (DESIGN.md section 16.B). How a subscription or membership is ended, per merchant. An entry gives a link ('url') only when its own help page ('source_url') was read on 'checked_on'; a link older than 60 days is not given, the steps are. Entries without source_url give no link and no merchant steps: the bot asks how the person pays, then gives the Apple or Google Play page, or the general steps. Aliases are distinctive names only (never 'max', 'calm', 'prime', 'plan' or 'premium' alone). Round 10, slice D (DESIGN.md section 17.D), facts read on 17 Nov 2026 (research_cancel_do sections 2.1 and 2.2): 'final_names' (the merchant's own words on its last button) and 'domains' (where its cancel pages are) are for the browser of slice V and are never shown as links; 'notice_post' (where a written notice goes by post), 'notice_deadline' (the merchant's own deadline, in plain words), 'notice_days' (the check date offered after a notice went; 'notice_business_days' when the merchant counts business days) and 'deadline' are shown only from an entry whose page was read.

apple.name: Apple
apple.path: Settings › your name › Subscriptions › {name} › Cancel Subscription
apple.note: Apple says to cancel a free trial at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

google_play.name: Google Play
google_play.path: the Play Store › Subscriptions › {name} › Cancel subscription

merchants.name: Netflix
steps: Go to the "Manage your membership" page and sign in if it asks.
Press "Cancel".
Press "Finish Cancellation".

merchants.name: Spotify
steps: Go to "Manage your plan" on Spotify's website and sign in if it asks.
Press "Cancel subscription".

merchants.name: YouTube Premium
steps: Go to "Paid memberships" on YouTube (in the app: your profile picture › Paid memberships).
Tap the membership.
Tap "Continue to cancel", pick a reason, then "Yes, cancel".

merchants.name: Peacock
steps: Go to Plans in your Peacock account and sign in if it asks.
Press "Cancel All Subscriptions" and follow the steps. Peacock says it emails you to confirm.
If you can't sign in, Peacock says you can cancel through its help chat.

merchants.name: Microsoft
steps: Go to Services & subscriptions in your Microsoft account and sign in with the account that pays for it.
Find the subscription and press "Manage".
Press "Cancel" and follow the steps on the page.
merchants.germany: Microsoft says a subscription bought in Germany can be cancelled without signing in.

merchants.name: Dropbox
steps: Sign in on dropbox.com.
Click your picture or initials, then "Manage account".
Click "Cancel plan" at the bottom of the page and follow the steps.

merchants.name: HelloFresh
steps: Sign in on HelloFresh's website.
Click your name, then "Account Settings".
On the Plan settings page, click "Cancel Plan" under Status. HelloFresh says to do it by 11:59 pm Pacific time, 5 days before your next delivery.
merchants.deadline: by 11:59 pm Pacific time, 5 days before your next delivery

merchants.name: Amazon Prime
steps: Go to the Prime membership page on Amazon's website and sign in if it asks.
Follow the steps there to end your membership. Amazon says members who haven't used their benefits may get a full refund.

merchants.name: Audible
steps: Sign in on audible.com.
Click your name, then "Membership details".
Click "Cancel membership", then "Confirm cancellation". Audible says credits you haven't used are lost.

merchants.name: Planet Fitness
merchants.notice_deadline: at least 7 days before your next billing date

merchants.name: LA Fitness
merchants.notice_deadline: postmarked at least 5 business days before your next billing date, and suggest certified mail
